correctness.rationale: Circle covariance kills every nonbalanced trace word in (R*R)^m by invariance, and Schatten Hölder bounds each remaining balanced trace by ||T||_{2m}^{2m}. Direct binomial counting yields C_m(t). For m>=2, one weighted balanced term Tr((T*T)^(m-1)TT*) is strictly below its Hölder upper bound unless T is normal; a nonzero compact normal circle-covariant operator cannot exist because its nonzero eigenvalue would have an uncountable rotational spectrum. Long nilpotent shifts have all interior diagonal trace coefficients equal to C_m and O(m) endpoint correction, proving uniform sharpness without attainment. At m=2 expansion gives exact 2t²(1-t)²||T*T-TT*||_2². Independently checked finite shift moments (N=3,5,11,41, m=1..4) and quartic identity; no claim this finite test proves infinite Hilbert-space case.
